name: Muscat
summary: Muscat combines a spectacular coastline between arid mountains and the Gulf of Oman with one of the safest and most stable environments in the Persian Gulf. The city offers a very high quality of life and low crime, although the cost of living is medium-high for the region and the summers are extremely hot. The community of digital nomads is still very small, making it a more suitable destination for those seeking tranquility than an intense social life.
